mn140:19.15: When they feel a pleasant feeling, they know: ‘I feel a pleasant feeling.’
mn140:19.16: They know: ‘With the cessation of that contact to be experienced as pleasant, the corresponding pleasant feeling ceases and stops.’
mn140:19.17: Painful feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as painful.
mn140:19.18: When they feel a painful feeling, they know: ‘I feel a painful feeling.’
mn140:19.19: They know: ‘With the cessation of that contact to be experienced as painful, the corresponding painful feeling ceases and stops.’
mn140:19.20: Neutral feeling arises dependent on a contact to be experienced as neutral.
mn140:19.21: When they feel a neutral feeling, they know: ‘I feel a neutral feeling.’
